title: Industrial Design Internship
note: Six-month internship in Italdesign's Industrial Design Department for new graduates; fluent Italian and English (B2+) required.

facts.summary: Six-month on-site internship in the Industrial Design Department of Italdesign, a Turin automotive and product design firm.
facts.duties: Market analysis, concepts and storytelling, hand and digital sketches, 2D and 3D renderings, and polygon or surface modeling for products, with a tutor.
facts.requirements: Degree in industrial or product design; Photoshop, Rhino, Blender or Alias, and KeyShot; fluent Italian and English (B2+).
